task.description: Type C or D design for ISS-0670. Design the platform-event convention: (1) Establish a PLATFORM_INSTANCE_ID constant (e.g. all-zeros UUID or a well-known value like 00000000-0000-0000-0000-ffffffffffff) seeded in instance_projections at startup/migration. (2) Design Store.appendPlatform() or a Store.append() override that accepts the platform instance_id without the InstanceNotFound check. OR: design a lower-level platform-event insert path that bypasses instance_projections entirely and writes directly to the events table with a platform-scoped partition. (3) In partition_maintenance.zig::ensurePartitionAttached(), after the partition is created, call the platform-event append with EXECUTION_PARTITION_CREATED, partition_name, range_bounds payload. Specify: exact API, exact call site in ensurePartitionAttached(), any migration needed for platform instance seeding, test spec updates for PAR-02 AC5.

result.summary: Design for platform-event append convention (ISS-0670) — type: E (novel cross-cutting). Recommends Option A (Store.appendPlatform + new src/event_store/platform.zig constants, no migration for instance_projections). Covers PAR-02 AC5 call site (ensurePartitionAttached line 328), idempotency-key shape, payload shape, registry seed migration for EXECUTION_PARTITION_* types, TC-PAR-02-09 test stub, and reuse path for all six EXECUTION_* platform events.
